plot_i18n.en_US: A pragmatic paleontologist touring an almost complete theme park on an island in Central America is tasked with protecting a couple of kids after a power failure causes the park's cloned dinosaurs to run loose.

items.stars: Sam Neill, Laura Dern, Jeff Goldblum

plot_i18n.en_US: Following the Normandy Landings, a group of U.S. soldiers go behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper whose brothers have been killed in action.

items.stars: Tom Hanks, Matt Damon, Tom Sizemore

plot_i18n.en_US: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

items.stars: Russell Crowe, Joaquin Phoenix, Connie Nielsen
items.writer: David Franzoni, John Logan, William Nicholson

plot_i18n.en_US: After thirty years, Maverick is still pushing the envelope as a top naval aviator, but must confront ghosts of his past when he leads TOP GUN's elite graduates on a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice from those chosen to fly it.

items.stars: Tom Cruise, Jennifer Connelly, Miles Teller
items.writer: Jim Cash, Jack Epps Jr., Peter Craig
